answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 15 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the jade solution is checked at the prism gate and logged, the ocean audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Slashing removes 44 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
